summary: Completed comprehensive testing of v2 API endpoints for BitBot Pro multi-bot architecture. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Fixed a security issue where hashed_password was being exposed in the /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/members endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Security issue in /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/members - was exposing hashed_password field. Added exclusion for hashed_password and verification_code in MongoDB projection.
Credential masking works correctly - bot_token and other sensitive fields are properly masked with bullet characters (•)
Auth guards working correctly - 401 for missing auth, 404 for wrong org/bot IDs
Overlap detection for connections works - returns 409 when same account+destination combination exists
All v2 endpoints properly require X-Org-ID header for org-scoped operations
Backward compatibility maintained - v1 endpoints (/api/admin/instances, /api/admin/bot-config) still work
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix: TEST_Org_v2_API, TEST_Bot_v2_API, TEST_Bot_Update, TEST_Bot_Updated, TEST_Discord_Account, TEST_Telegram_Account, TEST_Connection_Account, TEST_Connection_v2, TEST_Toggle_Connection, TEST_Overlap_First
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2 API endpoints fully tested. Key endpoints: GET/POST /api/v2/orgs (list/create orgs), GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id} (org detail with X-Org-ID header), GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/members (members with org_role and is_owner), GET/POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots (list/create bots with connection_count), GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id} (bot detail with knowledge_source_count), PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id} (update name/persona), GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/settings (full behaviour settings), GET/POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts (list/create accounts with masked credentials), GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id} (account detail with connections list), GET/POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections (list/create connections with enriched account info and effective_settings), PATCH /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections/{conn_id}/toggle (toggle enabled state). Migration data: org_id=cb91e73c-b74b-45a3-aecc-f7823ee07d2c, bot_id=f014cae7-788f-447c-b524-7d72709daa80.

features_tested.feature: GET /api/v2/orgs returns list of organisations with id, name, bot_count, member_count, account_count
POST /api/v2/orgs creates new organisation, creator becomes owner
GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id} returns org detail with X-Org-ID header
GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/members lists members with org_role and is_owner fields
GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots lists bots with connection_count and active_connection_count
POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots creates new bot with default settings
GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id} returns bot detail with knowledge_source_count
PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id} updates bot name and persona
GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/settings returns full behaviour settings

GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id} returns account detail with connections list

POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections creates connection linking bot to account+destination

Auth guard: requests without Authorization header return 401
Auth guard: requests with wrong X-Org-ID return 404

Backward compatibility: GET /api/admin/instances still works
Backward compatibility: GET /api/admin/bot-config still works
POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections with overlapping destination+account returns 409
